lost_creature_rue_challenge.speaker: Rue
lost_creature_rue_challenge._comment: T3-ACTIVITIES, spec sec6's 'Lost Creature: track and recover a villager's missing bonded Creature'. Same one-character-is-the-giver shape Old Bram established: the first line is the flag `revealed_by` waits on, and it names whose creature this is.

lines.text: That's far enough. Whatever the Pasture Drover told you, that Meadowhart's mine now -- finders keepers, out here.

lines: It wandered off her land and I caught it fair. If you want to argue the point, argue it with my team instead.

lost_creature_rue_defeated.speaker: Rue
lines: All right, all right. Fair's fair -- you beat me for it.
It's not tacked up or trained to anyone; it'll walk straight home if you point it that way. Tell her it wasn't hurt.
